units.main_table: Mbps and microseconds; samples/VL/frame are counts
units.grouped_metrics: integer cycles; one cycle=0.008 us; NA=no accepted delivery

definitions.jitter: max over VL of same-VL max latency minus min latency
definitions.gbe77_release: No independent O release event; release metrics fall back to M

policy.latency: L_gmii and L_app <=2000us for all frames/scenarios
policy.burst: Simultaneous planned queue release followed by serial single-port handshake; report both application-completion and planned-release latency/jitter

validation.ce2: Old 38/7 evidence reused; new test and filtered judge case natively rerun after approval
validation.ce1: Two full simulation records rechecked after approval; not resimulated
validation.all_frame_latency_checks: L_gmii and L_app <= 2000 us including warmup; zero requirement errors
validation.jitter_limit: REPORT only; 50 us is project reference, not an official limit
